userReview.scope: User acceptance of the delivered five-map environment sample direction and presentation; not full-map integration or whole-MVP acceptance.

scope: Five bounded production-renderer environment samples; opt-in, not formal campaign integration or MVP acceptance.
implemented: Source-bound natural cliff diffuse/normal/specular and opaque depth
Body gloss/environment/mask and original static type-9 terrain projections
Posed-footprint fitting inside unchanged native blockers, slope contact supports and partial rock burial
Five themed small layouts: prop clusters, material transitions, boundaries
Closed ice/lava/mine banks, lowered surfaces outside final walk cells, connected original cliff corner tiles
Scene-clock lava, soft decorative particle edges, pause/resize/context restore/retry

historicalFailures: First build syntax error and sandbox child-process EPERM retained in task history.
Runtime r1 had two favicon 403 console errors; repaired with an inline favicon.
r1 disconnected cliff corners and white ice rim; r2 corner connections still had unequal ground heights; r3 fixed common foundation and caps.

The two *-old-* captures in runtime-r1/r2/r3 and first final-lifecycle initial query were redirected without query parameters. Their own before=false reports identify them as sample captures, not baseline evidence. Correct verified-baseline-* images are only in final-lifecycle-r2.
Optional DefaultWater.dds catalog placeholder had no extracted file. Frozen water uses verified original IceWorld2 pixels.
limits: Boundary sites are beyond the final walk region, not walls at the current fog frontier.
Viewer uses the actual terrain, map loader, lighting, shadow/contact and HDR render modules with an independent controllable scene clock; no combat playthrough is claimed.
Original lava layers and UV motion are an adaptation; no full water physics or exact source-engine POM/refraction parity.
Static scenery source channels repaired here do not constitute every original M3 ambient particle or animation feature.
25 sites are bounded samples. Full five-map distribution, natural gameplay, physical inputs, human review, final performance and production/B4 remain open.
No application/HTML release, Current mirror sync, Git push, or publication in this batch. Earlier evidence and other workstreams retained.
